_README: One entry per JERSEY = one in-game uniform + the front-end team-select sheet that mirrors it.
Editing texture0 (stamps<->decals) or texture1 (normal<->decals_normal) must be written to
BOTH, which is what launcher/jerseys.py does on Apply. idx2..5 (helmet/letters/crowd) exist
Built by hashing decoded texture0 of every uniform_*/disc_* asset: the sheet's `decals` is a
byte-identical copy of the uniform's `stamps`. Where several uniforms share one image (the
20 teams whose home and away art is identical, and the creation-zone slots), content cannot
say which sheet belongs to which uniform, so they are paired by OFFSET RANK - the Nth uniform
by offset <-> the Nth sheet by offset, within an archive. That rule reproduces 145/145 of the
'leftovers' = assets with no counterpart (front-end-only sheets, or uniforms we haven't paired).
